rapport_notes: Warm, personable, reassuring tone; handled the customer's hesitation about the move date with genuine flexibility and zero pressure.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; silence not fully held after open-ended questions (rep continued talking after the agenda question and after 'does that feel fair' wasn't explicitly asked).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: "do you have a few moments to go over that information?" — asks for time but does not frame the exchange with a time-box or explicit promise of an accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I go over the details, do you have any specific concerns or questions that you would like answered on this call?" — asked before logistics probing started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised uncertainty about move date ('the date is not final'). Rep acknowledged and pivoted to logistics without probing deeper: no 'tell me more,' no follow-up on whether there were other concerns. Single-layer, then move forward.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Covered in Stage 2 takeaway: 'We do have our no worries damage coverage which is our free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate that provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace our reimburse for accidental damages.'
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Covered in Stage 2 takeaway: 'The second is our meet your mover feature. A few days before you move, you'll receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you helping ease attention of strangers arriving at your door.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Covered in Stage 2 takeaway: 'Finally, we do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So we can't make it in the time window that we arrange. We mainly start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.communication: Never mentioned. No day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox updates beyond the meet-your-mover email.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: 'The typical move this size would take two movers, one truck between three and a half to five and a half hours. And then since, we are moving from a third floor apartment with elevator access, and a bit of a walk to a fourth floor apartment with elevator. I would looked you your move taking four and a half to five and a half hours and we look to budget Between 9:36. And $1,144' — range given and personalized to apartment floors/elevator/walk.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: 'Obviously their number of factors involved when determining move time. But the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there.' — acknowledges move time varies.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: 'I do know that you are gonna take some of the small things over yourself and a car load or two. I would really help keep the time down in our efficiency up obviously the last time we take less money you end up spending at the end of the day' — connects self-prep to cost savings.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: 'would you like me to get you on the schedule today' — direct ask to book.

top_strength: Brianne expertly handled the customer's date flexibility concern by immediately reframing it as zero-risk and offering to change anytime — this removed the primary objection and allowed the close to flow naturally.
coaching_note: Two gaps to close: (1) After the agenda question, probe at least one layer deeper into the date concern ('what else is important to get right on this move?') before pivoting to logistics, and (2) Communication (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) was never mentioned — deliver it as part of the Stage 2 takeaway alongside on-time and damage coverage.
